messages.subject: scatterplot error:object 'input' not found
parts:
Hi,

I have 2 sets of radio button for x & y variable names called varX and varY on the side panel and I use those 2 variables to do a scatter plot.  At first i used the plot function below and it works:

plot(dataset[,input$varX],dataset[,input$varY], xlab = input$varX, ylab = input$varY, main = title)


Then I tried to change the function to scatterplot so i can do reg.line
  scatterplot(dataset[,input$varY] ~ dataset[,input$varX], reg.line=TRUE, spread=TRUE,boxplots=FALSE)

but i got the error 
Error: object 'input' not found

Any ideas why?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: scatterplot error:object 'input' not found
parts:
That is a problem (bug?) of the car package, which can be easily
manifested by the minimal example below:

library(car)
f = function(input) {
scatterplot(df[, input$y] ~ df[, input$x])
}
df = data.frame(a=1:10, b=rnorm(10))
f(list(x='a', y='b'))

However, I think you can also avoid the formula interface, and just
use scatterplot(x, y) instead of scatterplot(y ~ x).

Regards,
Yihui
